summary: Full-stack testing of TradeLens FastAPI + SQLite backend and React/TypeScript frontend. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering /api/health, watchlist CRUD (add/duplicate 409/delete/404), trades CRUD (LONG/SHORT side computed, pnl computed, newest-first, 204/404), settings GET/PUT persistence, market-summary (3 indices + 4 focus + status/asOf), opportunities (10 items with all fields), stock detail curated (RELIANCE 13-pt), synthesized (TCS 13-pt), 404 NOTREAL, and stocks search. Frontend Playwright E2E: dashboard renders all cards with API data, 10 watchlist rows, Today's Focus symbols RELIANCE/TATAMOTORS/ADANIENT/ASIANPAINT visible, clicking watchlist rows (TCS, HDFCBANK) updates ChartCard to that symbol (regression from iteration 1 FIXED - now works for non-curated symbols via synthesize_insight backend), header search 'ADAN' shows dropdown with search-add-ADANIENT button, add works and row appears in watchlist. /watchlist page delete (ITC removed successfully). Journal New Trade dialog fills submit (RELIANCE 100/110/10), dialog closes, journal-row-1 appears, delete removes it. Settings prefilled from backend (capital=500000, risk=1.5), timeframe chip click persists and shows saved badge, Save Changes clicked. Refresh button clicked without error. No mock JSON imports remain (src/mocks does not exist, grep '@/mocks' returns 0). No direct axios/fetch outside /src/services.

issues: Recharts still logs 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warning on every chart mount / route with the chart. Benign but noisy — this issue was already flagged in iteration_1.json and is not yet fixed. Add explicit min-height (e.g. min-h-[280px]) to ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Fix recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning by giving ChartCard's ResponsiveContainer parent an explicit min-height.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separates routers, DB seeding runs only on empty DB — idempotent.

trades.py side calculation (LONG if exit>=entry) does not treat pnl sign-neutral for SHORT positions — for a SHORT with entry=200 exit=180 qty=5 the pnl returned is -100 (negative) while side='SHORT'. If UX expects 'positive pnl on winning short', this is incorrect. Currently frontend just displays pnl signed and colors green/red by sign, which for the above short yields a red (-100) even though the short was profitable. Consider computing pnl as (entry-exit)*qty when side==SHORT, or documenting the sign convention explicitly. Not blocking the review request but worth flagging.
schemas.py TradeCreate requires trade_date as datetime — frontend sends ISO datetime via new Date(...).toISOString(), which works. Good.
seed_data.STOCKS_BY_SYMBOL supports synthesize_insight fallback so every watchlist symbol has a chart. Iteration-1 regression is resolved by backend.
